drivers.title: Flash PMI growth relief
drivers.fact: August flash services PMI 56.8; composite PMI 56.0; manufacturing PMI 53.2.
drivers.read_through: Strong services postponed immediate slowdown concerns but did not remove inflation or rates risk.

drivers.title: Long-end yields and oil stayed elevated
drivers.fact: 10Y 4.73%, 30Y 5.266%; Brent US$94.39, up 6.39% for the week.
drivers.read_through: Friday's equity rebound did not resolve the discount-rate and reflation constraint.

drivers.title: Weekly positioning remains fragile
drivers.fact: S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell 1.43% and 2.05% for the week despite Friday's gain.
drivers.read_through: Treat the move as a relief rally until rates, oil and earnings confirmation improve together.
